newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Degussa opens new Belgian production unit.
newsitem.headline: Degussa opens new Belgian production unit.

text.p: Degussa Antwerpen NV, the Belgian subsidiary of German chemicals and metals group Degussa AG, has opened a new 800 million franc plant boosting production of an additive for tyres, the port of Antwerp said on Thursday.

The Antwerp plant now accounts for 6,000 tonnes -- half of Degussa's worldwide production -- of the Si 69 additive used to produce low-rolling-resistance tyres, also called "green tyres", the Port of Antwerp Promotion Association said in a statement.
Such green tyres cut fuel consumption by up to five percent and have improved technical characteristics, it said.
